name: WeekSync Scheduler
author: Rohan Patel

sections.description:
WeekSync Scheduler is a powerful WordPress plugin that automatically generates and sends weekly reports of your Gravity Forms entries via email. Perfect for businesses, agencies, and website owners who need regular insights into their form submissions.

Key Features

  • Automated Weekly Reports: Set up recurring weekly email reports with customizable schedule
  • Form Selection: Choose which Gravity Form to include in your reports
  • Flexible Scheduling: Configure day of the week and time for report delivery
  • Multiple Recipients: Send reports to multiple email addresses
  • One-Time Reports: Send immediate reports or schedule specific date reports
  • Comprehensive Logging: Track all report activities with detailed logs
  • User-Friendly Interface: Easy-to-use admin interface with tabbed navigation
  • Gravity Forms Integration: Seamlessly works with Gravity Forms plugin

Use Cases

  • Weekly lead generation reports
  • Monthly form submission summaries
  • Automated client reporting
  • Form performance monitoring
  • Data export and backup

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Gravity Forms plugin (active)

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit the plugin support forum.

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. All form data processing is done locally on your WordPress installation. Email reports are sent only to the recipients you specify in the plugin settings.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/weekly-gravity-form-data directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Weekly Gravity Form Data to configure your reports
  4. Select your Gravity Form and set up your email recipients
  5. Choose your preferred schedule and save settings
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with Gravity Forms?

Yes, this plugin is specifically designed to work with Gravity Forms. You need to have Gravity Forms installed and activated for the plugin to function properly.

Can I send reports to multiple email addresses?

Yes, you can send reports to multiple recipients by entering comma-separated email addresses in the settings.

Can I schedule reports for specific dates?

Yes, the plugin allows you to send one-time reports immediately or schedule them for specific dates and times.

How do I view the report logs?

You can view all report activities in the Logs tab within the plugin settings page.

What happens if I change the schedule?

When you update the schedule, the plugin automatically reschedules the next report based on your new settings.
